_meta.route_note: web only. The source says an API exists but its tier gating conflicts across sources, and there is no official MCP here, so no API call is planned: Claude generates in the user's signed-in app from a checklist (browser automation) and the download goes through asset-persist.
_meta.price_note: Suno credits are a subscription pool, not money per call. ~5 credits per song comes from the source's own tier figures (Free 50 credits/day ~ 10 songs; Pro 2,500 credits ~ 500 songs). PROVISIONAL: read the cost in the app before generating.
_meta.rights_note: Generate on a paid plan only (free-tier songs are non-commercial forever). Commercial rights are not ownership; no indemnification while litigation runs. See plugins/audio/skills/suno/SKILL.md.
